caption: The drawing depicts a woman standing and facing slightly to the left. She has pale skin and dark brown hair styled in an elaborate updo. She is wearing a full-length, off-the-shoulder dress with long sleeves. The dress features a blue and white plaid pattern with horizontal and vertical stripes, and it has a ruffled blue trim along the hem and sleeves, as well as a large bow or bustle at the back of the waist. She holds a white or light gray handbag with one hand at her waist. The woman’s earrings are red and round. The background is a plain, light beige color with no additional objects or scenery. The artist's signature and the date “1939” appear in the bottom right corner.
title: Baltimore Doll
